name: Tali AI
description: Tali AI is Canada's leading AI clinical workflow platform with ambient scribing, EMR integration, billing, and forms—all with 100% Canadian data residency. Pricing: Free tier (5 scribes/month), Part-Time CA$80/month, Pro CA$135/month (~US$99) unlimited with 14-day trial. Key differentiator: PHIPA and PIPEDA compliant with all data stored in Canada, making it the go-to choice for Canadian clinicians with provincial privacy requirements. Integrates with Canadian EMRs including OSCAR, Accuro, and PS Suite. Not for US practices (no HIPAA focus) or mental health therapists (use Mentalyc or Upheal). Best for Canadian primary care and multi-specialty practices wanting a complete clinical platform beyond just scribing.

faqs.q: How much does Tali AI cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Tali AI offers a free tier (5 scribes/month), Part-Time at CA$80/month (~US$59), and Pro at CA$135/month (~US$99) unlimited. Students and residents get unlimited free accounts. 14-day Pro trial available. Billing add-on available for additional fee.

faqs.q: Is Tali AI compliant for Canadian healthcare?
faqs.a: Yes. Tali AI is 100% PHIPA and PIPEDA compliant with all data stored on Canadian servers. This makes it the go-to choice for Canadian clinicians with provincial privacy requirements that mandate Canadian data residency.

faqs.q: What Canadian EMRs does Tali integrate with?
faqs.a: Tali AI integrates with major Canadian EMRs including OSCAR (Canada's most widely used open-source EMR), Accuro, PS Suite, and Med Access.

faqs.q: Is Tali AI good for mental health practices?
faqs.a: Not specifically. Tali is designed for primary care and general medical documentation. Canadian mental health therapists should use Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo). For Canadian-specific compliance, note that Scribeberry is also PIPEDA compliant.

faqs.q: Tali AI vs Scribeberry: which is better for Canadian practices?
faqs.a: Both are PIPEDA compliant with Canadian focus. Tali (CA$80-135/mo) offers a complete clinical platform beyond scribing—task management, forms, billing. Scribeberry (Free-$99/mo) focuses purely on AI scribing with a more generous free tier (20/mo vs 5/mo). Choose Tali for platform features, Scribeberry for scribing focus.
